integrity: Geometric fixed-point orbit identification and unrestricted recursive acyclic matching prove the integer homotopy types. Independent finite orbit-face, matching, and homology checks corroborate, not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite paths under reversal only. The qualitative interval-family sphere-or-point theorem and the r=2 reflected-path formulas were already known; the surviving classification concerns exact dimensions and residue criteria for the full r-parameter family, especially r>=3. No classification of general tree automorphisms is asserted.
title: Reflection-fixed homotopy types of higher path-independence complexes
